name: Academic Writing with AI questionnaire (simulated)
source: Simulated for teaching (seed 2026). Not real respondents. True structure: three correlated factors with five items each.

items.text: I can organise my ideas clearly when I write in English.
I can write a well-structured academic paragraph without help.
I can revise my own drafts to make them clearer.
I feel confident using academic vocabulary accurately.
I can explain the main argument of my essay in one sentence.
I check AI-generated text against reliable sources.
I notice when an AI tool gives a confident but wrong answer.
I question whether AI suggestions fit my own argument.
I accept AI-generated references without checking them.

items.text: I compare answers from AI with what my teacher has taught.
I find it hard to start writing without an AI tool.
I use AI to write sentences I could write myself.
I feel anxious when I cannot use AI for an assignment.
I let AI decide how to structure my essays.
I copy AI wording into my assignments with few changes.
